newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Basis offers flat to sharply up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Basis offers flat to sharply up.

text.p: Extremely tight supplies of soymeal for nearby delivery, a smaller-than-expected crush and talk of vigorous export business pushed most soymeal basis offers higher Friday, soymeal brokers said.
"There's just nothing out there for the next couple of weeks," one river broker said.
Many locations in the Midwest have run out of spot soymeal and are not quoting offers, cash market sources said.
Problems at some crushing plants and a low protein content in the new-crop soybeans were cited as reasons that the weekly crush came in below most expectations, brokers said.

The National Oilseed Processors Association reported Thursday that the weekly soybean crush was 29.898 million bushels, slightly below the 30.000 million that most in the trade were expecting and which would have set a record.
The futures market was rife with rumors Friday that China bought 50,000 tonnes of soymeal and was looking for another 50,000, but exporters could not confirm the talk.
